alerts.all_off_hint: All alerts are currently off. Nothing is shown in the stream, not even a test.
alerts.basics_hint: Applies to every alert. The area is centred horizontally; the offset counts from the top edge of the overlay.
alerts.duration_invalid: The duration has to be between 1 and %{max} seconds.
alerts.lead: The frame for alerts in the stream. What is shown comes from plugins – size, duration and the master switch live here.
alerts.media_hint: Leave empty and the video is as wide as the area, with the height following the aspect ratio.
alerts.name: Alerts
alerts.no_tabs: No alert plugin is installed yet. Without one the area stays empty.
alerts.permissions.edit: may change size, duration and position of the alerts.
alerts.permissions.test: may trigger a test alert in the stream.
alerts.permissions.toggle: may switch all alerts on and off at once.
alerts.tab_failed: The “%{tab}” tab could not be displayed. The details are in the log.
alerts.test_hint: Sends an alert without video or sound to the overlay. To see it, the area has to be open – in the browser or in OBS.
alerts.test_while_off: Alerts are off – switch them on first, then test.
alerts.toggle_hint: Switch all alerts on or off at once
alerts.width_invalid: The width has to be between 160 and 3840 pixels.
